summary: The PR resolves the minversion issue by replacing LooseVersion with packaging.version.parse. It introduces a new test script to reproduce the issue.

issues.description: The PR introduces a new dependency on the 'packaging' package, which should be documented and added to the setup.py requirements.
The PR adds a new test script 'reproduce_issue.py', but it should be integrated into the existing test suite for better maintainability.
